description: Linux kernel driver source code for Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA, implementing firmware loading, DMA setup, hardware initialization, and control functions for ACA hardware.

methods.name: aca_fetch_fw_file
methods.description: Fetch firmware file from filesystem based on device and filename.

methods.name: dc_aca_free_fw_file
methods.description: Release firmware resources.

methods.name: aca_dma_parse
methods.description: Parse DMA configuration from firmware data.

methods.name: aca_sram_desc_parse
methods.description: Parse SRAM descriptor sections from firmware data.

methods.name: aca_init_parse
methods.description: Parse initialization parameters from firmware data.

methods.name: aca_fw_parse
methods.description: Parse firmware image headers and addresses.

methods.name: aca_section_parse
methods.description: Parse firmware sections including SRAM, DMA, and firmware images.

methods.name: aca_fetch_fw_api
methods.description: Fetch and parse firmware file, validate headers, and initialize firmware sections.

methods.name: aca_fetch_fw
methods.description: Wrapper to fetch firmware file.

methods.name: aca_fw_download
methods.description: Download firmware to hardware via memory-mapped registers.

methods.name: aca_dma_ctrl_init
methods.description: Initialize DMA controller.

methods.name: aca_dma_port_init
methods.description: Initialize DMA port settings.

methods.name: aca_dma_ch_init
methods.description: Initialize individual DMA channel.

methods.name: aca_dma_ch_off
methods.description: Disable all DMA channels.

methods.name: aca_xbar_ia_reject_set
methods.description: Set reject bit for an interconnect agent.

methods.name: aca_xbar_ia_reject_clr
methods.description: Clear reject bit for an interconnect agent.

methods.name: aca_xbar_ia_reset
methods.description: Reset an interconnect agent.

methods.name: dc_aca_shutdown
methods.description: Shutdown ACA hardware, reset interconnects.

methods.name: aca_mem_clear
methods.description: Clear firmware and SRAM memory regions.

methods.name: dc_aca_start
methods.description: Start ACA functions with specified task mask.

methods.name: aca_sw_reset
methods.description: Perform software reset of ACA hardware.

methods.name: dc_aca_stop
methods.description: Stop ACA functions, optionally reset hardware.

methods.name: dc_aca_clk_on
methods.description: Enable clock for ACA hardware.

methods.name: dc_aca_clk_off
methods.description: Disable clock for ACA hardware.

methods.name: dc_aca_reset
methods.description: Reset ACA hardware.

methods.name: dc_aca_info_init
methods.description: Initialize internal ACA info structure.

methods.name: aca_umt_msg_addr
methods.description: Get UMT message address based on endianness and type.

methods.name: dc_aca_event_addr_get
methods.description: Get event register addresses.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_sub_ack
methods.description: Write acknowledgment value for TXIN.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_hd_cnt
methods.description: Read TXIN hardware descriptor count.
